label: Install dependencies from the lockfile
code:
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci

label: Copy the sources, compile, then drop devDependencies
code:
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src ./src
RUN npm run build && npm prune --omit=dev
